items.title: The Four Lust-Cravings Matched to Four Corpse-Stages

items.zh: 若於變赤作意思惟，於形色貪令心清淨。若於其骨、若於其鎖、若於骨鎖作意思惟，於妙觸貪令心清淨。若於散壞作意思惟，於承事貪令心清淨。如是四種，名於婬貪令心清淨。是故世尊乃至所有依外朽穢不淨差別，皆依四種憺怕路而正建立。謂若說言：由憺怕路見彼彼屍，死經一日，或經二日，或經七日，烏鵲、餓狗、鵄鷲、狐狼、野干、禽獸之所食噉，便取其相，以譬彼身亦如是性，亦如是類，不能超過如是法性。此即顯示始從青瘀乃至食噉。若復說言：由憺怕路見彼彼屍，離皮肉血，筋脈纏裹。此即顯示所有變赤。若復說言：由憺怕路見彼彼骨，或骨、或鎖。此即顯示或骨、或鎖、或復骨鎖。若復說言：由憺怕路見彼彼骨，手骨異處，足骨異處，臗骨異處，膝骨異處，臂骨異處，肘骨異處，脊骨異處，髆骨異處，肋骨異處，頷輪、齒鬘、頂髑髏等各各分散，或經一年、或二，或三，乃至七年，其色鮮白，猶如螺貝，或如鴿色。或見彼骨和雜塵土。此即顯示所有散壞。如是依外所有朽穢不淨所緣，令於四種婬相應貪，心得清淨。
items.en: Attending to the corpse turning red purifies craving for physique. Attending to bones, to their linking joints, or to a full skeleton purifies craving for touch. Attending to their scattering purifies craving for being served. These four together purify lust-craving. … Through the charnel path one sees corpse after corpse: dead one day, two days, seven days, devoured by crows, magpies, starving dogs, vultures, foxes, wolves, jackals, and other creatures … this shows the sequence from livid through devoured. … Seeing corpses stripped of skin, flesh, and blood, sinew wrapped around bone alone — this shows the turning-red. … Seeing bone after bone, bones held by sinew, or a skeleton of linked bones — this shows bone, bones held by sinew, and the linked skeleton. … Hand-bone in one place, foot-bone in another … up to seven years later, bleached white as a shell — this shows the scattering. Thus, through the object of external decaying impurity, the mind is purified of the fourfold lust-craving.

items.title: Section: All Five Kinds of Craving Matched to Their Antidotes

items.zh: 由苦惱不淨所緣，及下劣不淨所緣故，令於境相應若欲若貪，心得清淨。由觀待不淨所緣故，令於色相應若欲若貪，心得清淨。由煩惱不淨所緣，及速壞不淨所緣故，令於從欲界乃至有頂諸薩迦耶若欲若貪，心得清淨。是名貪行淨行所緣。如是且約能淨貪行，總說一切通治所攝不淨所緣。今此義中，本意唯取朽穢不淨，所餘不淨亦是其餘淨行所緣。
items.en: Through the object of impurity-of-suffering and the object of base-impurity, the mind is purified of desire and craving connected with sense-objects. Through the object of comparative-impurity, the mind is purified of desire and craving connected with form-realm absorption. Through the object of afflictive impurity and the object of swift-decay impurity, the mind is purified of desire and craving for the self-existing view, from the desire realm up to the summit of existence. This is called the object that purifies craving-conduct. … This has broadly explained, with respect to purifying craving-conduct, the impurity-objects that serve as its universal antidote. In this treatise's own intention, the original purpose was solely decaying impurity — but the remaining kinds of impurity likewise serve as objects for purifying the other kinds of craving-conduct.

items.title: Loving-Kindness Object: Definition and Its Four Scriptural Names

items.zh: 云何慈愍所緣？謂或於親品、或於怨品、或於中品，平等安住利益意樂，能引下中上品快樂定地勝解。當知此中，親品、怨品，及以中品是為所緣；利益意樂、能引快樂定地勝解，是為能緣。所緣、能緣總略為一，說名慈愍所緣。若經說言：慈俱心者。此即顯示於親怨中三品所緣利益意樂。若復說言：無怨、無敵、無損害者。此則顯示利益意樂有三種相。由無怨故，名為增上利益意樂。此無怨性二句所顯，謂無敵對故、無損惱故。不欲相違諍義，是無敵對。不欲不饒益義，是無損害。若復說言：廣大無量。此則顯示能引下中上品快樂。欲界快樂名廣，初二靜慮地快樂名大，第三靜慮地快樂名無量。若復說言：勝解遍滿具足住者。此則顯示能引快樂定地勝解。
items.en: What is the loving-kindness object? It is abiding equally, with a benefit-wishing attitude, towards loved ones, enemies, or neutral persons alike — an attitude that gives rise to lower, middle, or upper grades of blissful concentrative resolve. … Loved ones, enemies, and neutral persons are the object; the benefit-wishing attitude that gives rise to bliss is the subject. Object and subject together are called the loving-kindness object. Where scripture says "a mind accompanied by loving-kindness," this shows the benefit-wishing attitude towards the three categories as object. Where it says "without resentment, without hostility, without harm," this shows the benefit-wishing attitude has three aspects. … Where it says "vast, great, immeasurable," this shows the bliss of lower, middle, and upper grade it gives rise to: desire-realm bliss is called vast; the bliss of the first two absorptions is called great; the bliss of the third absorption is called immeasurable. Where it says "resolve pervading, fully abiding," this shows the blissful concentrative resolve itself.

items.zh: 又此勝解，即是能引快樂利益增上意樂所攝勝解作意俱行。

items.title: Section: Loving-Kindness, Compassion, and Sympathetic Joy Distinguished; Fascicle 26 Complete

items.zh: 若於無苦無樂親怨中三品有情，平等欲與其樂，當知是慈。若於有苦、或於有樂親怨中三品有情，平等欲拔其苦，欲慶其樂，當知是悲、是喜。有苦有情是悲所緣，有樂有情是喜所緣，是名慈愍所緣。若有瞋行補特伽羅，於諸有情修習慈愍，令瞋微薄，名於瞋恚心得清淨。
items.en: Towards the three categories of person who feel neither suffering nor pleasure, equally wishing to give them happiness — this should be known as loving-kindness. Towards the three categories who are suffering, or who are joyful, equally wishing to relieve their suffering or to rejoice in their joy — this should be known as compassion, and as sympathetic joy. Suffering beings are the object of compassion; joyful beings are the object of sympathetic joy. This is called the loving-kindness object. If a person's dominant affliction is hatred, cultivating loving-kindness towards all beings thins that hatred — this is called purifying the mind of hatred.

blocks.text: How each kind of impurity cures a particular craving, then the second purifying object, loving-kindness. Fascicle 26 ends today.

"Attending to the livid corpse purifies craving for complexion; to the corpse turning red, craving for physique; to bones and skeleton, craving for touch; to their scattering, craving for being served." Venerable Miào Jìng: blood, flesh, and skin gone; sinew still binding bones. Master Cháng Bǎi: in ancient India a charnel road showed corpses dead one day, two days, seven days.

Suffering and base impurity purify craving for sense objects; comparative impurity, craving for form-realm absorption; swift decay, craving for identity. Master Cháng Bǎi: the impurity object can be shallow or deep.

"Abiding equally, with a benefit-wishing attitude, towards loved ones, enemies, and neutral persons alike." Its bliss is graded: "desire-realm bliss is called vast; the bliss of the first two absorptions great; the third absorption's bliss immeasurable".
"Towards those who feel neither suffering nor pleasure, wishing to give them happiness: loving-kindness. Towards those suffering: compassion. Towards those who are joyful: sympathetic joy."
This fascicle mapped the people and the objects of meditation. Fascicle 27 continues with the remaining purifying objects: dependent origination, the elements, and breathing.

quiz.q: How does Master Cháng Bǎi illustrate the fourth lust-craving, "craving for being served"?
options: someone who serves you as you wish and cooks well, binding your stomach and your heart
quiz.why: "Craving for complexion, craving for physique, craving for pleasing touch, and craving for being served." Master Cháng Bǎi: someone who does things your way, serves you, cooks wonderfully — they bind your stomach and so bind your heart.

quiz.q: "Stripped of skin, flesh, and blood, sinew wrapped around" shows the turning-red; the English has "sinew wrapped around bone alone." How does Venerable Miào Jìng describe it?
options: blood, flesh, and skin gone, sinew perhaps still binding the bones, maybe a little blood left
quiz.why: Venerable Miào Jìng: the blood, flesh, and skin are gone; perhaps sinew still binds the bones, maybe a little blood remains. This matches the English, though Master Cháng Bǎi elsewhere misreads it as sinew gone too.

quiz.q: Which impurity-object purifies craving connected with form absorption, and what does Master Cháng Bǎi say about self-view?
options: comparative impurity; with "I" come "you" and "they," opposition arises — self-grasping is the root of saṃsāra
quiz.why: "Through the object of comparative-impurity, the mind is purified of desire and craving connected with form-realm absorption." Master Cháng Bǎi: with a self, the mind is not pliant; with "I" there is "you" and "they," and opposition — self-grasping is the root cause of beings' cycling through birth and death.

quiz.q: The loving-kindness object treats loved ones, enemies, and neutrals equally. What order does Master Cháng Bǎi suggest?
options: loved ones first, then neutrals, then enemies — enemies are hardest
quiz.why: "Abiding equally, with a benefit-wishing attitude, towards loved ones, enemies, or neutral persons alike." Master Cháng Bǎi: loved ones are easier, so first bring loved ones to mind, then neutrals, then enemies — enemies are hard.

quiz.q: How does the text map "vast, great, immeasurable" to grades of bliss, and why does Venerable Miào Jìng say the third absorption is "immeasurable"?
options: desire-realm bliss is vast, first two absorptions great, third immeasurable — the third is the happiest in the three realms
quiz.why: "Desire-realm bliss is called vast; the bliss of the first two absorptions is called great; the bliss of the third absorption is called immeasurable." Venerable Miào Jìng: of the desire, form, and formless realms, the third absorption is the most blissful, so it is called immeasurable.

quiz.q: Suffering beings are compassion's object, joyful beings sympathetic joy's. How does Venerable Miào Jìng say loving-kindness, compassion, and joy are practised?
options: not only loving-kindness, but compassion and joy as well
quiz.why: "Suffering beings are the object of compassion; joyful beings are the object of sympathetic joy. This is called the loving-kindness object." Venerable Miào Jìng: loving-kindness, compassion, joy — one cultivates not just loving-kindness but compassion and joy too. The English title says "Four Immeasurables," but text and lectures treat only three.
